description: Cases that need the generated library physically present. The library is 216 files and is not in the repository, so this suite cannot run in CI; it is run locally against a library produced by scripts/demo/make_library.py and verified, file by file, against benchmarks/libraries/synthetic-demo.library.json before any case executes.
ci_exclusion_reason: needs the 216-file synthetic library on disk (scripts/demo/make_library.py), which is not committed. Run: python3 -m memory_engine_eval.runner run --library DIR --library-declaration benchmarks/libraries/synthetic-demo.library.json benchmarks/synthetic-library.suite.json

cases.measures: the fraction of the library's files whose BLAKE3, recomputed off the disk right now, equals the digest the generator's MANIFEST declares -- the media_id ingest will derive for that file
cases.does_not_measure: anything about the pictures; two libraries with identical bytes and different subject matter score the same

falsifications.why: editing one declared digest must be caught by a probe that genuinely recomputes -- a probe reading the manifest back to itself would still report 1.0 on a library whose media had been swapped -- and one file in 216 can only move the score by 1/216, which is why the bound sits just under 1

swapping two files' declared digests leaves the file set, the file count and the multiset of digests unchanged, so only a per-file comparison catches it; two files in 216 is the whole size of the effect
